Outsider (Evil, Lawful) · SM +0 Chain Devil (Kyton) (Enraged Eggplant; answers SRD 3.5)

A lean, scarred figure in an iron half-mask, wearing a mantle of interlocked black chain that does not hang the way metal should. The chains move at its will, striking from angles no arm could reach, and it holds a victim's gaze while they do. It heals what you cut, and it is in no hurry.

Melee attacks

UsageLevelDamageReach
PunchPunch (11): thrust 1d crushing (KYOS: 1d+2 crushing), Reach C. The damage includes the +1 bonus for improvised brass knuckles.11thrust 1d crushing (KYOS: 1d+2 crushing)C
ChainsChains (15): The chain devil has two long chains that it can use to attack enemies. These chains deal swing 2d crushing, Reach 1-4*. The chains are awkward enough that they require a Ready maneuver to change reach (e.g., between 1 and 3). Otherwise, the chain devil can strike at foes that are at any distance within the chains’ reach. Attempts to parry the chains are at -4, and fencing weapons cannot parry at all! Attempts to block chains are at -2. This swinging attack is unbalanced – the chain devil cannot use it to parry if it has already used it to attack this turn (or vice versa), and parries with the chains are at -2. The chain devil has two chain attacks, which permits him Dual-Weapon Attacks (p. B417). The chains have DR 4 and effective weight 1.4 lbs. This attack uses the Kusari skill.15The chain devil has two long chains that it can use to attack enemies. These chains deal swing 2d crushing1-4*
Dancing ChainsDancing Chains (15): The chain devil can animate any chain within 10 yards of him. He can animate up to 8 yards of chain, assuming the chain weighs 2 lbs. per yard. 8 yards of chain have 20 HP. An animated chain can grab, lift, strike, and throw with ST equal to its HP/2. It has the chain devil’s DX. It can walk and jump if it isn’t fixed in place; Move equals 10–HP/2. The chain devil can use skills through animated chains (including Kusari to make swinging attacks) – but note that chains have No Fine Manipulators. Chains return to their rest state once the chain devil gives up control.15The chain devil can animate any chain within 10 yards of him. Unnerving GazeUnnerving Gaze (11): The chain devil can make its face resemble one of an opponent’s departed loved ones or bitter enemies with a Concentrate maneuver. The victim must be within 10 yards. Roll a Quick Contest of Will with the victim. If the chain devil wins, roll 3d for the Fright Check result, as usual, but add his margin of victory instead of his margin of failure.11The chain devil can make its face resemble one of an opponent’s departed loved ones or bitter enemies with a Concentrate maneuver.
